Security verdict: PASS WITH NOTES

PR: #144
Head: 165c32215126ed72e5eb8949431f090cde50d559
Scope: only 464e061..165c322; closure review of prior S001 and security review of the remaining delta.

No new vulnerabilities found. Prior S001 (MEDIUM), cross-project queued-request metadata disclosure on a failed scope read, is CLOSED at this head. queue_scope preserves lookup failures rather than turning them into missing scope: own, parent, or prime lookup errors make the digest log "queued role requests unavailable" and omit the queue. A successfully resolved empty scope performs no queue reads.

The shared-build --doc path and EXIT-trap changes introduced no exploitable shell/path injection in the reviewed delta.

Proof and limitations:
- GitHub reports the exact head CLEAN and all five reported checks SUCCESS, including rust-lint and rust-test. CI: https://github.com/AI-Substrate/pij-fleet/actions/runs/42229916587
- Source review found coverage for failed assignment reads and the prime lookup guard. The broken assignments table makes both own and parent reads fail, so it does not isolate parent-only failure.
- The final prime-lookup test is a guard, not an old-code-failing regression.
- No local builds or tests were run, as requested. This is not a re-review of the earlier implementation or a claim of live deployment proof.
